dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Well, Mr. Flins, now we're completely out of options.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Who on earth came up with the idea to have Miss Aino attend the big meeting at headquarters? It couldn't possibly have been her request, could it?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Please tell me this is part of some new "trick."

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: It certainly is. When a solitary leaf takes to the breeze, it cannot fail but draw the eye. Yet, when a multitude of leaves depart in unison, the singular form can no longer be distinguished.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Sharp as ever, I see. Still, I must express my great regret for being unable to participate in such an enlightening assembly.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Be that as it may, Mr. Flins, look at all the "autumn leaves" in this building. I imagine all of them would love to fly away quickly...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: I can already imagine all their excuses: Stomachaches, headaches, outstanding assignments, emergency deployments—

choices.text: How are you so familiar with these?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Nope. They've used up all the excuses and left none for me.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: I mean, good heavens, we once had twenty Ratniki down with stomachaches, fifteen who hurt their legs in a fall, six struck by fevers, and eight with urgent matters to attend to.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: If an outsider saw this, they'd think our headquarters had been raided by the Wild Hunt!

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: In all fairness to them, if this place were genuinely to face a sudden incursion of the Wild Hunt, I am confident that they'd be here in full force.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Ahaha.. ha. Very funny, sir, but I have no intention of attending a meeting with the Wild Hunt.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: And neither do I. Yet as we both know, the Wild Hunt seem to have a special fondness for playing the part of uninvited guests...

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Anyhow, I'm usually the only one left in the entire meeting room. And then, I still have to deliver the meeting minutes to the absentees after it's done.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Then I must extend my sincere gratitude for your efforts.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Could you come by yourself next time, then?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: As I said before, such "frustrations" likewise possess an uncanny propensity to show up without invitation.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: *sigh* When can this poor leaf finally drift away...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: No need to drift away completely... just a little further than the nearest leaf.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Thank you, but I'm the leaf nearest to you, aren't I?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Rest assured, Young Master, we'll all make landfall together. Besides, I'm inclined to believe that no autumn leaf ever falls where it shouldn't.

choices.text: You've skipped your fair share too, haven't you?
The more people there are, the easier it is to skip class.
